title.zh: 动理学镜约化 Hall 平衡

summary: Bind the grid mirror kinetic closure to the pressure port of the reduced-Hall anisotropic Picard graph, so each Hall field and flux state is evaluated by the kinetic graph before the next magnetic update.

identity.relation: grid mirror kinetic pressure state to reduced-Hall magnetic-flux feedback
identity.direction: R-Z mesh, vacuum flux, Green response, ion properties and kinetic configuration -> terminal Hall equilibrium mapping
identity.definition: Copy kinetic_config, then bind a pressure_closure(B,psi) which calls the grid mirror kinetic TaskGraph with the current Hall B and psi and with the outer r_grid/z_grid overriding any same-named kinetic_config entries. Remove kinetic_config from the Hall payload, replace any supplied pressure_closure with the bound closure, and return the reduced-Hall TaskGraph result unchanged. The outer wrapper performs no magnetic update itself; the nested Hall graph owns its bounded Picard and optional Hall-inertia iterations and reevaluates the kinetic closure at its terminal state.
identity.model: axisymmetric grid mirror end-loss/quasineutral kinetic closure coupled to reduced-Hall anisotropic Picard feedback
identity.geometry: rectilinear cylindrical R-Z grid accepted by both nested graphs; the bound Hall graph requires at least three nodes on each axis
identity.coordinates: fields use [Z,R] array indexing; nested Hall supplies psi=R A_phi in Wb/rad and the dense Green matrix follows its C-order cell-current convention. The outer binding passes that psi without conversion to the kinetic flux-profile coordinate.
identity.boundary: Caller supplies vacuum flux, dense Green response, plug-plane positions and kinetic reference data; the composition adds no free-boundary response or coordinate conversion.
assumptions: The kinetic_config supplies all remaining required kinetic graph ports and is scientifically compatible with the outer Hall ion properties; every psi-dependent kinetic profile interprets psi=R A_phi in Wb/rad.
The two nested graphs interpret magnetic field, flux and pressure using compatible conventions; the wrapper does not verify this beyond their existing contracts.
Dependency-injection hooks can replace the bound nested callables for testing, but such overrides are not evidence for the canonical scientific composition.

inputs.name: r_grid
inputs.description: Cylindrical radius grid passed to both child graphs.
inputs.constraints: Rectilinear, nonnegative R axis, strictly increasing with at least three columns; same shape as z_grid and psi_vac.

inputs.name: z_grid
inputs.description: Axial grid passed to both child graphs.
inputs.constraints: Rectilinear, strictly increasing Z axis with at least three rows; same shape as r_grid and psi_vac.

inputs.name: psi_vac
inputs.description: Vacuum psi=R A_phi and initial Hall Picard state.
inputs.constraints: Same grid shape; copied by the Hall graph and passed unconverted as the kinetic flux-profile coordinate.

inputs.name: g_psi
inputs.description: Dense cell-current-to-psi response for the Hall graph.
inputs.constraints: Exact finite square shape and Hall Picard C-order cell-current mapping, with no embedded 2*pi or cell-area factor.

inputs.name: ion_mass_kg
inputs.description: Ion mass passed to Hall drift.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive in the Hall leaf; independently provide the corresponding kinetic_config.mass_kg.

inputs.name: ion_charge_c
inputs.description: Positive ion charge passed to Hall drift.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive in the Hall leaf; independently provide the corresponding kinetic_config.charge_c.

inputs.name: kinetic_config
inputs.description: Fixed inputs for each evaluation of the nested grid mirror kinetic closure.
inputs.units: mixed SI; psi-dependent profiles use Wb/rad
inputs.constraints: Must be a dict. The bound graph requires mass_kg, charge_c, density_ref_m3, temperature_parallel_j, temperature_perpendicular_ref_j, electron_temperature_j, reference_z, plug_left_z and plug_right_z. Optional kinetic controls, their defaults and validation are defined by scirel.kinetic.grid-mirror-kinetic-closure; r_grid, z_grid, b_t and psi are supplied from the current Hall call and override matching entries. Psi-dependent profiles must interpret the Hall psi=R A_phi in Wb/rad. The wrapper does not reconcile kinetic mass/charge with the Hall mass/charge.

inputs.name: tol
inputs.description: Outer Hall relative flux-change stopping threshold.
inputs.constraints: The Hall graph checks finiteness, not positivity; choose a positive value for intended stopping.

inputs.name: maxiter
inputs.description: Hall Picard update bound.
inputs.constraints: Integer >= 1; outer nonconvergence returns converged=false if terminal checks pass.

inputs.name: relax
inputs.description: Previous-flux weight in Hall Green update.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= value < 1.

inputs.name: minimum_field
inputs.description: Hall update field floor.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive; checked during updates, not repeated at terminal reevaluation.

inputs.name: minimum_firehose_margin
inputs.description: Terminal active-cell firehose threshold.
inputs.constraints: Negative disables the terminal threshold; nonnegative values reject active cells at or below it.

inputs.name: plasma_mask
inputs.description: Fixed or state-dependent Hall active-cell policy.
inputs.constraints: Null selects all cells; fixed and callable masks must match the grid.

inputs.name: hall_multiplier
inputs.description: Hall drift multiplier.
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative.

inputs.name: include_toroidal_inertia
inputs.description: Enable the Hall leaf's bounded local inertia correction.
inputs.constraints: Actual boolean scalar; not numeric 0/1.

inputs.name: hall_density_floor_fraction
inputs.description: Relative density floor for Hall-active drift support.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= value < 1.

inputs.name: maximum_inertial_mach
inputs.description: Ion-drift Mach cap in Hall leaf.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive.

inputs.name: inertia_relax
inputs.description: Previous-current weight in Hall local inertia iteration.
inputs.constraints: 0 <= value < 1.

inputs.name: inertia_tolerance
inputs.description: Hall local inertia stopping threshold.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive.

inputs.name: inertia_max_iterations
inputs.description: Hall local inertia iteration bound.
inputs.constraints: Integer >= 1; local nonconvergence raises.

inputs.name: compatibility_tol
inputs.description: Terminal parallel-momentum error threshold.
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative; exceedance raises only with strict_compatibility=true.

inputs.name: ohm_tolerance
inputs.description: Terminal normalized generalized-Ohm error threshold.
inputs.constraints: Strictly positive; exceedance raises only with strict_compatibility=true.

inputs.name: strict_compatibility
inputs.description: Reject Hall terminal compatibility threshold exceedance.
inputs.constraints: Actual boolean scalar; the separate firehose check remains active.

inputs.name: kinetic_graph
inputs.description: Optional explicit substitute for the bound kinetic TaskGraph.
inputs.constraints: Dependency-injection hook, selected by Python truthiness; an override changes the scientific composition and is not the canonical asset.

inputs.name: hall_graph
inputs.description: Optional explicit substitute for the bound Hall TaskGraph.
inputs.constraints: Dependency-injection hook, selected by Python truthiness; an override changes the returned mapping and is not the canonical asset.

outputs.name: psi
outputs.constraints: Returned unchanged from the Hall graph after one or more updates.

outputs.name: plasma_cell_currents
outputs.constraints: Recomputed by the Hall graph at terminal psi.

outputs.name: J_phi
outputs.constraints: Hall active-cell mask applies.

outputs.name: B_R
outputs.constraints: Derived from terminal psi.

outputs.name: B_Z
outputs.constraints: Derived from terminal psi.

outputs.name: B
outputs.description: Terminal poloidal-field magnitude passed into the last kinetic evaluation.
outputs.constraints: The Hall graph does not repeat minimum_field at this terminal evaluation.

outputs.name: p_parallel
outputs.description: Terminal kinetic parallel pressure after Hall scalar broadcast.
outputs.constraints: Taken from the terminal kinetic closure and shape-coerced by Hall.

outputs.name: p_perpendicular
outputs.description: Terminal kinetic perpendicular pressure after Hall scalar broadcast.
outputs.constraints: Taken from the terminal kinetic closure and shape-coerced by Hall.

outputs.name: parallel_force
outputs.description: Terminal Hall force along magnetic field.
outputs.constraints: Hall diagnostic, not an independent physical validation.

outputs.name: force_R
outputs.constraints: May include centrifugal correction.

outputs.name: force_Z
outputs.constraints: Returned from Hall state.

outputs.name: ion_toroidal_velocity
outputs.constraints: Zero outside Hall-active cells.

outputs.name: electron_toroidal_velocity
outputs.constraints: Zero outside Hall-active cells.

outputs.name: electric_field_R
outputs.constraints: From kinetic electrostatic_potential through the Hall leaf.

outputs.name: electric_field_Z
outputs.constraints: From kinetic electrostatic_potential through the Hall leaf.

outputs.name: hall_state
outputs.constraints: Returned by the child graph without outer modification.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.constraints: False at maxiter is returned if terminal gates pass.

outputs.name: iterations
outputs.constraints: Between one and maxiter inclusive.

outputs.name: relative_psi_change
outputs.constraints: Uses the bound Hall graph's norm convention.

outputs.name: parallel_force_error
outputs.constraints: Compared with compatibility_tol.

outputs.name: generalized_ohm_error
outputs.constraints: Compared with ohm_tolerance.

outputs.name: closure_state
outputs.description: Unmodified mapping from the last grid mirror kinetic call.
outputs.constraints: Includes the kinetic graph's density, pressure, potential and diagnostic fields; may not match Hall-broadcast primary pressure shapes if a custom kinetic override is used.

outputs.name: firehose_margin
outputs.constraints: Checked on active cells when minimum_firehose_margin >= 0.

outputs.name: compatibility_messages
outputs.constraints: Can be nonempty on successful return only when strict_compatibility=false.

outputs.name: iteration_history
outputs.description: Hall per-update flux/current and Ohm diagnostics.
outputs.constraints: Each item records iteration, relative_psi_change, relative_current_change and generalized_ohm_error.

preconditions: The outer and kinetic mass/charge entries, flux and field conventions, pressure model and grid geometry are physically compatible; the wrapper does not reconcile them.
The kinetic configuration can evaluate the current Hall field and flux at every outer update and terminal reevaluation.
The caller Green response and plug-plane/reference inputs follow the two bound child contracts.
supported: Binding the saved grid mirror end-loss/quasineutral pressure closure into an axisymmetric reduced-Hall Picard equilibrium with explicit nested dependencies.
excluded: A demonstrated real end-to-end physical parity with the source project or general proof of compatibility between the two child graphs.
Automatic flux-unit conversion, free-boundary reconstruction, non-axisymmetric dynamics or correction of inconsistent kinetic and Hall species parameters.
Guarantee of outer Picard or nested kinetic/ambipolar convergence for arbitrary inputs.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: The outer wrapper rejects missing/non-dict kinetic_config or missing required outer keys with ValueError. Nonmapping positional inputs raise TypeError in compose. Nested graph validation then rejects malformed grids, Green response, species data, kinetic controls and pressure state; errors propagate without wrapper repair.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Any kinetic, Hall, field, end-loss, quadrature, local-inertia or compatibility exception propagates; no alternate pressure model or partial equilibrium is returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: The Hall outer graph can return converged=false at maxiter after successful terminal checks. A nested ambipolar/end-loss or Hall local-inertia failure may raise instead; the outer wrapper does not retry.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial mapping is returned after an exception. A successful Hall result is passed through unchanged, including converged=false when applicable.

The old admitted-assets record and Pleiades import hashes are development lineage, not approval in the present expert-review lifecycle; this maintained implementation is not asserted byte-identical to the saved source.

example.description: Exercise the public binding contract with explicit test substitutes; this does not verify the canonical scientific coupling.
example.expected: The mock Hall graph calls the bound pressure closure, which receives the current B and psi plus the outer grid; the mock result passes through unchanged.

scope: Direct public-wrapper and historical composition tests show that current B/psi and the outer grid are injected into the kinetic payload without conversion and that its state is returned through the Hall pressure port.

A manufactured vacuum psi=0.5*R^2 yields B_Z=1 T at interior radii; its radial density profile, prescribed plug potentials, matched ion properties and synthetic nonzero diagonal Green response exercise both default nested graphs together. The outer Picard converges with strict compatibility enabled; the test checks a nonzero flux update, current, pressure gradient and local charge residual.

A separate manufactured 17x17 case uses two circular-filament vacuum sources and the mirror-plasma flux Green response with one active plasma cell. Both default nested graphs run with nonzero Hall drift and strict compatibility enabled. At one off-source point, terminal plasma flux and finite-grid B_R/B_Z increments match a separately evaluated plasma filament flux and field; the field increments have a 10% finite-grid derivative tolerance. Disabling Hall removes the Hall-specific radial electric-field contribution.

The nested grid kinetic graph's fixed-profile case is invariant under consistent 2*pi rescaling of its psi interpolation coordinate; this does not cover unadjusted psi-dependent callbacks. Child graph tests separately exercise selected end-state mapping, confinement, profile validation and reduced-Hall controls.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Two manufactured per-radian cases demonstrate actual nested numerical execution and bounded Picard convergence, including one circular-filament/mirror-Green coupling with one active cell and nonzero Hall drift. One off-source point also checks plasma-only field increments within 10% of direct filament fields; this is not a grid-convergence study. The tests do not establish same-input source parity, real-device physical validation, arbitrary psi-dependent profile interoperability, full parameter-domain convergence, expert approval or release.
known_limitations: The wrapper never checks that Hall ion_mass_kg/ion_charge_c agree with kinetic_config.mass_kg/charge_c.

The historical saved kinetic graph labels flux as Wb; this maintained composition passes Hall psi=R A_phi in Wb/rad without conversion. Every psi-dependent kinetic profile needs a matching coordinate definition, and the wrapper does not verify one.

A separate uniform-pressure manufactured input produced near-zero absolute force and electric-field residuals but normalized compatibility errors of 0.207 and 0.090 from floating-point cancellation; this sample does not establish a general tolerance policy.
The wrapper accepts alternate injected graph callables and unknown Hall payload keys; exact canonical behavior applies only to the default bindings.
Source license and expert approval of the current implementation remain pending.

nodes.description: Bind the nested kinetic callable; it is invoked later by Hall through pressure_closure for each current B and psi.
Copy kinetic_config and bind current Hall B/psi plus outer r_grid/z_grid into the kinetic callable; no scientific calculation is added.
Call the bound Hall graph once with its known inputs and the kinetic pressure callback; its own execution owns all feedback and terminal checks.
Return the Hall mapping without alteration; listed output keys are the canonical bound Hall graph's return contract.

execution.ordering: Validate outer required keys and dict kinetic_config; bind the kinetic callable and a pressure_closure that merges fixed config with outer grid and current Hall B/psi; invoke the Hall graph with that callback; return its mapping unchanged. The Hall child invokes the kinetic callback on each Picard step and terminal reevaluation.
branches: Optional callable hooks replace the canonical child bindings for testing; their behavior is outside this asset's scientific evidence.
Nested kinetic plug-potential and confinement branches follow its own exact contract; Hall mask, local inertia, compatibility and stopping branches follow the Hall exact contract.
execution.state_ownership: The wrapper owns only a shallow kinetic_config copy and callback binding. The nested Hall graph owns evolving psi, previous cell currents and iteration history; each kinetic call computes from its passed field/flux and fixed configuration.
execution.failure_propagation: Child exceptions propagate directly; there is no fallback closure or partial outer result.
